feed_summary: Overview While performing continuous red teaming exercises through Rapid7’s Vector Command service, Rapid7 discovered three new vulnerabilities in Eptura Archibus . A legacy API endpoint could be exploited to bypass authentication and run various functions without authentication ( CVSS: 8.6 High ). The most serious functions allow for full database read ( CVSS: 8.5 High ) and an insecure file upload ( CVSS: 9.6 Critical ). The insecure file upload leads to remote code execution. Product description Archibus helps organizations administer and manage their physical buildings, equipment, and real estate from a single central location.
